component.name: PandaManager
PandaManager
component.summary: File manager Next-Gen Dual-Pane & Hybrid per KDE Plasma 6
File manager dual-pane ibrido di nuova generazione per KDE Plasma 6

description.p: PandaManager is a next-generation, dual-pane hybrid file manager designed for KDE Plasma 6 and CachyOS. It combines a modern glass-morphism UI with powerful features including cloud storage integration (Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, MEGA, pCloud, Proton Drive, WebDAV, SFTP, SMB, S3/MinIO), rich media preview (images, video, audio, RAW photos, tracker modules), device management via UDisks2/Solid, and a thread-safe transfer queue with KIO integration.

PandaManager è un file manager dual-pane ibrido di nuova generazione progettato per KDE Plasma 6 e CachyOS. Combina un'interfaccia glass-morphism moderna con funzionalità avanzate: integrazione cloud (Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, MEGA, pCloud, Proton Drive, WebDAV, SFTP, SMB, S3/MinIO), anteprima multimediale ricca (immagini, video, audio, RAW, tracker module), gestione dispositivi via UDisks2/Solid e coda trasferimenti thread-safe con integrazione KIO.

ul.li: Glass morphism UI with KDE dark/light theme detection
Cloud storage via rclone (12+ providers, KWallet credential storage)
Media preview: 50+ formats including RAW, DSD, JXL, AVIF, BIK, MXF
QuickLook overlay for images, video, audio, and PDF
Column view (macOS Finder style) and breadcrumb navigation
GDPR-compliant: zero telemetry, Privacy by Design (Art. 25)
Accessibility: EN 301 549, AT-SPI2, WCAG 2.1 AA keyboard focus
CRA 2024/2847 compliant: SBOM, CVD policy, binary hardening
Scaffolding completo e conformità legale (Apache-2.0, CRA, GDPR, EN 301 549)
Motore multimediale con 50+ formati (FFmpeg, LibRaw, TagLib, libopenmpt)
Cloud engine sicuro via rclone JSON-RPC / D-Bus con KWallet
Device manager UDisks2/Solid con Polkit e protezione root
Transfer queue thread-safe con KIO e barra progresso live
UI glass-morphism: split-pane, breadcrumb, QuickLook, vista colonne
Suite di test CTest completa: unit, UI, mock D-Bus, coverage CI
Flatpak sandbox, PKGBUILD Arch/CachyOS, AppStream, SBOM SPDX
